narr: A slow moving upper level low pressure system interacted with a surface frontal boundary to induce torrential rain producing thunderstorms. These storms moved into Northeast Pennsylvania during the afternoon and repeatedly struck the same areas leading to localized flash flooding of roads, ditches and urban areas.
ev: Significant road flooding occurred at Litchfield Road and Blackberry Lane, involving clogged pipes.
High water was washing over the Lee Road and Park Hollow Road intersection.
A vehicle was stranded in water in Honesdale Borough, prompting a rescue call as per 911 county dispatch.
